## Expected and observed behavior

Include the exact visible status and whether the problem persists after reconnect/reopen. Do not repeat an uncertain
file-changing prompt just to reproduce it on important data; use a disposable project/profile.

## Work/data at risk

Were drafts acknowledged as saved? Is a submission or Stop outcome unresolved? Could a tool/file/remote effect
already have happened? Describe what you know; do not infer that timeout means cancellation.

## Minimal reviewed evidence

Optional screenshot or redacted diagnostic excerpt. Remove secrets, prompts, private source names and filesystem
paths as appropriate. Indicate what was omitted. Do not upload your entire profile by default.
